column2: Claude! Forty-five thousand database reads in three minutes! We're going viral!
Cleo... you haven't deployed it yet.
Your app only runs on localhost. Every one of those reads came from this desk.
I'm not even touching anything! The page is just sitting there!
Why is it counting like a slot machine?!
I wrote your useEffect with an empty array, so it fetched once. Did you touch it?
I made it refresh whenever the tasks changed. That's called being responsive!
So it fetches your tasks, gets a brand-new array, thinks the tasks changed, and fetches again. Forever.
Make it stop! Make it stop!
Done. The empty array is back. One request. Next time, test with the Network tab open.
At least we caught it before it cost anything.
Daily read limit reached. Reads blocked until tomorrow.
Claude... can you rewind the database too?
I can rewind my edits, Cleo. Not the calendar.
Great. I finally went viral... and my only fan was me.
